desc:
Welcome to Ride A Box! 📦💨

How to play:
📦 Hop in your box and slide as far as you can
💵 Earn cash based on your distance
🛒 Use your money to unlock faster, crazier, and cooler boxes
⭐ Reach the end for a huge bonus multiplier
🔧 Upgrade your speed, stability, and ultimate potential

🎁 Like the game to support updates, new boxes, and future rewards!

Join the group!
